description:
Create an organization connector from a Valet catalog entry. It is the step after list_catalog_connectors found the entry for the product the user named; attach_connector then lets a website's pages call it.

An entry that needs no key, or whose keys the organization already holds as secrets, is created at once. An entry that needs a key from a person is not created here. Say plainly in reason why it is needed. The answer carries a request whose url the person opens, signed in to Valet, to enter each key; the connector is created when they complete it, and its name is in the answer now. Give the person the url, then follow the request with get_request. Never ask the person to type a key into this conversation. Optional keys are not asked for; the person can add them on the dashboard's Integrations page.

An entry that authorizes in a browser, OAuth or a Composio toolkit, makes a request the same way: the person opens its url, signs in to the provider from there, and the connector is created under the name in the answer. An entry the organization already has is reported as already there; no second connector is made. Returns the connector's name, the catalog entry it came from, the slots filled from secrets the organization already held, whether a website can hold it, and the request when a person must enter keys or sign in. Requires connecting a Valet account.

entry.description: Required. The catalog entry's name, spelled exactly as list_catalog_connectors reports it.

org_name.description: The Valet organization to create the connector in. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

reason.description: Required when the entry needs a key or a sign-in from a person. One plain sentence, shown to the person on the request page, saying why the value is needed, such as: The app charges cards and needs your Stripe key. At most 280 characters.

name: create_connector
title: Create a connector from the catalog
